## About
Penn Muffler & Brake is a muffler, brake and suspension shop at 4100 Strand Ave in Pennsauken. We work on exhaust systems, brakes, shocks and struts, with parts from brands like Flowmaster and Monroe.
We'll look at your car, tell you what it needs, and give you a written estimate before we start. Sometimes the answer is that it doesn't need anything yet. One reviewer came in about a brake noise and Joe told him there were no issues.
We're rated 4.6 on Google from 524 reviews. Call ahead to schedule, or swing by the shop.

## Services
- Brake Repair: Long stops, squealing, a spongy pedal or a warning light that won't go off. Bring it in and we'll check it out.
- Brake pads and rotors: Replacing worn brake pads and rotors to keep your car stopping the way it should.
- Exhaust System Installations: Upgrading, servicing and repairing exhaust systems, including aftermarket exhaust installs.
- Mufflers, pipes and exhaust components: Mufflers and exhaust parts installed and replaced, so your car runs right and sounds good.
- Catalytic converters: Our catalytic converters meet the requirements set by the EPA and CARB for pollution reduction.
- Shocks and struts: Bumpy ride? We replace shocks and struts and handle suspension repairs.

## FAQ
Q: Can you just tell me if my car needs work?
A: Yes. We offer a no obligation inspection to help you figure out what's going on and whether it can wait.

Q: What are the signs my brakes need service?
A: A spongy or low brake pedal, a car that's hard to brake, a brake warning light that stays on, or brakes that squeal all the time. If you notice any of these, talk to one of our mechanics.

Q: How often should I get my brakes checked?
A: We recommend having your brake system checked once a year, even if you aren't having problems.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Saturday 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM. Closed Sunday.

Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: Calling to schedule is best. One reviewer came in as a walk-in and was in and out in a respectable amount of time, even on a busy day.
